verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own site names a 'Triage Agent' that 'prioritizes bugs' (clickup-docs-19), alongside 24/7 'Super Agents' that can be delegated tasks (clickup-docs-5). That is first-party evidence of AI triage, but it is a single marketing tagline with no documentation of how the agent works or what it automates. missing for 10: documentation of how the Triage Agent ingests and auto-triggers on incoming bugs and tasks, details of its prioritization logic and configuration, coverage of general tasks beyond bugs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
